items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: God I had seen Milton playing with Manny Klein and Matty Malneck... I think that was where Milton got his start

ctx.x: Oh he’s famous as a musical comedy script writer. But he wasn’t then, but he was like a writer for whatever. And well you have to know who he was. He was a funny guy. He used to write these funny songs, and he would entertain at parties, and he got so famous © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
doing that that they hired him to do a radio show with these funny songs he used to write. But it was a good little band, Milton DeLugg — does that name ring a bell?
